what_happened.line: The committee discussed closeout of the new school project, including a punch list of small remaining items and next steps with the state authority.
A motion to accept the requisitions was made and seconded, but the captions are too garbled to confirm the outcome.
The committee agreed that requisition signatures are sufficient, so it could skip meetings that only approve requisitions.
The presenter said a transfer of money will likely be needed to fix shaking classroom projectors once information arrives the following week.
The committee also heard about a drainage and ice condition near the site, then a roofing and solar contractor update, and ended with a motion to adjourn.

why_it_matters: Projector repairs and any remaining contingency are paid from the school project budget, so a transfer would decide whether those fixes draw on money already set aside for the building.
Fewer meetings for requisition approval means payments on the closing project may be signed off with less public discussion.
